items.title: TaMo PV posts Rs 5,531 crore Q2 loss, revenue rises 34%
items.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles has reported a consolidated loss of ₹5,531 crore for the second quarter. Revenue has increased by 34% to ₹96,920 crore, though it slightly missed market estimates. The loss marks the company's steepest in the last 22 quarters following a profitable year earlier. The domestic passenger vehicle segment achieved record quarterly revenue, primarily due to increased sales volumes.

items.title: Grasim Industries Q2 profit triples to 2,306 cr, revenue up 33%
items.description: Grasim Industries reported a profit of ₹2,306 crore for the September quarter, nearly tripling year-on-year. Revenue reached an all-time high of ₹12,747 crore, indicating strong growth across core businesses. The cellulosic fibres segment saw a 29% revenue growth, while the decorative paints business experienced a 35% increase. In contrast, the chemicals business faced challenges with declining profitability. Overall, there was a notable disparity in standalone and consolidated financial results.

items.title: Zetwerk Q2 net loss widens 43%, revenue increases 18%
items.description: Zetwerk reported a 43% increase in net loss to ₹88.11 crore during the September quarter, compared to last year. Revenue from operations rose 18% to ₹4,599.36 crore, a decline from the previous quarter's growth. Losses from continuing operations widened significantly while the discontinued business saw a reduced loss. The company faced increased finance and employee stock option costs contributing to its net loss.

items.title: Eicher Motors Q2 net profit rises 15% to Rs 1,573 crore, misses estimates
items.description: Eicher Motors reported a 15% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to ₹1,573 crore in the September quarter, missing analysts’ estimate of ₹1,626 crore as higher raw material costs offset gains from strong sales. Revenue rose 20% to ₹7,422 crore, while EBITDA increased 16% to a record ₹1,760 crore.
